scripts.dev:infra: docker compose --project-directory . -f deployment/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && npm run seed
scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -k -n ui,bff,agent -c blue,cyan,green "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:bff" "npm run dev:agent"
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -k -n ui,bff,agent -c blue,cyan,green "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:bff" "npm run dev:agent"
scripts.dev:coachme: concurrently -k -n ui,bff,agent -c blue,cyan,green "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:bff" "npm run dev:agent"
scripts.dev:full: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -k -n ui,bff,agent,mcp -c blue,cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:bff" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev:mcp"
scripts.dev:agent: cd apps/agent && uv run langgraph dev --port 8133
scripts.judge:coachme:
node -e "console.log('
CoachMe+ (zero Docker):
  Root .env: COPILOT_RUNTIME_SSE_ONLY=1, COACHME_ZERO_DOCKER=1
  apps/agent/.env: COACHME_SKIP_NOTION=1, COACHME_USE_MCP=1 (default), GEMINI_API_KEY
  npm run dev:coachme   OR three terminals: dev:ui, dev:bff, dev:agent
  Open http://localhost:3010/coach — MCP is spawned by the agent (no separate MCP terminal).
  TwelveLabs: COACHME_USE_MCP=0 + TWELVELABS_*
')"
